skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the impacts of economic, social, demographic, and labor factors on human resource decisions.
Work effectively with group members, demonstrating communication, presentation, analysis, synthesis, and problem-solving skills.
Use quantitative and qualitative techniques proficiently for analyzing human resource economics data.
Show initiative in learning, research, and teamwork.
Demonstrate appropriate professional ethics and responsibility.
Evaluate government policies related to social security and unemployment issues.
Understand the structure and distribution of human resources and their relationship with population.
Analyze the impact of micro and macro factors on the labor market.
Apply problem-solving skills to address issues in human resource economics.
Select and apply appropriate research methods and present research results effectively.
